Name: Animal Mood Fix
Author: GTrain86
Description:
This fixes the bug in Stardew Valley where animals at a high mood/happiness rating will revert back to an extremely low mood when you pet them.
This bug has been detailed here: [url=http://stardewvalleywiki.com/Animals#Mood]http://stardewvalleywiki.com/Animals#Mood[/url]

This mod should fix any bug where the mood for animals reverts back to a low level.

It has only been tested against SDV 1.11 (although it should work with 1.1 as well) and SMAPI 1.2 (it may work fine with earlier versions, this is a very simple mod).

It shouldn't break any other mods and doesn't alter your save files.


Update 1.1
 * Fixed another bug in SDV where some types of animals will stop producing items when they have a high mood+friendship value.
   This may not work for the first day after installing the mod, but should work on all subsequent days.

Downloads.Description: Fixes the animal moods so that it doesn't loop back to 0 when you pet them and they are at full mood. Also fixes bug where some types of animals will stop producing when they have high mood+friendship values.
